name: Ubiquity Ventures
identity_check: Confirmed as Ubiquity Ventures (ubiquity.vc), the seed-stage firm Sunil Nagaraj (ex-Bessemer) launched in 2017 to back technical founders building 'software beyond the screen'. SEC EDGAR lists Ubiquity Ventures I-IV, L.P. (Delaware, business location Palo Alto, CA) plus Ubiquity-named SPVs for portfolio companies (Esper, Loft Orbital, Halter). Not Ubiquiti Inc. (networking hardware), not Ubiquity Inc. (customer-experience outsourcing) and not Ubiquity6 (AR startup).

thesis_text.value: Single-GP pre-seed and seed fund backing small teams of technical founders, often pre-product or pre-revenue, who extend software into the physical world ('software beyond the screen'), from robotics and agtech to space, healthcare and climate. Leads or co-leads with $1-3M checks, takes board seats at seed, and decides quickly; explicitly not moonshots and not SaaS.

first closing end of September 2017 (TechCrunch 2019); initial Form D filed 2017-09-21
conflicts.reason: The contemporaneous announcement and the amended Form D both date the final close to 2019-01-23; the 2024 '2018' is a later recap.

conflicts.reason: $51.2M is the precise SEC-reported figure and agrees with the firm's '$50+ million'; the firm announced the close on 2021-06-23. TechCrunch's '2020' matches the initial Form D (2020-02-25), not the close.

conflicts.reason: $12.6M is the exact announced figure ($13M is rounded). The firm's own post claims co-lead, so Ubiquity is kept as a lead; press names AlleyCorp alone.

open_items: Fund IV (Ubiquity Ventures IV, L.P.): Form D filed 2025-12-16 (EDGAR full-text search), but no size, target or announcement found; the team page still says Sunil 'manages three deep-tech funds'. www.sec.gov refused the 'CapitalAtlas research' User-Agent, so Form D amounts for Funds I-IV were not read.
Fund III close_date is the announcement date (2024-01-30); its Form D was filed 2022-08-26 and amended 2023-12-15. No exact final-close date is published.
Lead list: $30M (2019-01-23) and $75M (2024-01-30) match; Fund II recorded at $51.2M (SEC figure via press) rather than $50M, close 2021-06-23 (Form D/A 2021-06-21).

invests_in_indian_founders and requires_us_entity: neither the site nor press states a location or entity requirement. Portfolio page lists non-US companies (Halter, New Zealand; Route Reports, UK; Levl, Israel).
Sunil Nagaraj's LinkedIn URL is not linked from ubiquity.vc, so it is left null.

Halter Series D ($100M at $1B, July 2025, led by BOND): Ubiquity's post and the round description name no Ubiquity participation, although EDGAR lists a 'Ubiquity Halter D SPV, LLC' Form D (2025-07-09); not recorded as a round.
BusRight's $30M round (2026-03-18, led by Volition Capital): Ubiquity's blog celebrates it but neither it nor the release says Ubiquity invested in this round; not recorded.

Eclipse Space seed: amount undisclosed (CEO declined per search summary; not confirmed on a fetched page); date recorded as the stealth launch 2026-06-29; the Business Wire launch release returned 403.
ElastixAI (Ubiquity 'backs' post 2026-04-07): round amount, stage and co-investors not found.
Splash Industries ($4.2M, 2026-07-22) and Olis Robotics ($4.1M, 2023-08-11): stage not labelled by the sources, recorded as undisclosed.

Candidate rounds not verified on a round page: BluePill seed (~$6M, Nov 2025, Ubiquity reportedly lead), Derapi seed ($7M, Feb 2026, Earthshot reportedly lead), ThruWave seed ($6.4M, reportedly co-led with E14 Fund, 2020), Ubicept follow-on (aggregator lists $4.6M, June 2025).
